body:
did you know "All Too Well (10 Minute Version)" holds a chart record that will probably never be broken?

at over 10 minutes long, it's the longest song in history to hit #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 -- beating a record that had stood for decades.

a track she wrote at 22, shelved in a vault for ten years, then re-recorded in full as part of taking her masters back. it didn't just chart -- it topped the whole thing.

that's not a fluke. that's a fanbase streaming a 10-minute song straight into the record books.

longlivets.com
why: Did-you-know track-fact pillar. Sourced directly from the vault (vault-evermore-all-too-well-10-minute-version-becomes-the-longest-song-ever-to-hit-no-1, 2021-11-22). Evergreen, not date-locked. Media: Red era art (the song's home era) rather than the evermore filing, since the song itself reads as Red to fans.
